bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Zeitgeist Arts.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ZEITGEIST ARTS.

$1,100,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Zeitgeist Arts to facilitate community arts access by restoring and renovating the historic Zeitgeist Arts building in downtown Duluth.
additions: $1,100,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Zeitgeist Arts to facilitate community arts access by restoring and renovating the historic Zeitgeist Arts building in downtown Duluth.
